intro: Norway is a constitutional monarchy with a parliamentary democracy. Its 1814 constitution is the oldest still in use in Europe, and Oslo is home to the Nobel Peace Prize.

chapters.title: King and Storting
text: King Harald V has reigned since 1991. The parliament, the Storting, has 169 members elected by proportional representation and chooses the government.
A committee chosen by the Storting awards the Nobel Peace Prize each December in Oslo.

chapters.title: Norway and Europe
text: Norway is not in the EU, but through the European Economic Area it follows most EU single-market rules and its people can live and work across Europe. It is a founding member of NATO. On 17 May, children's parades fill every town.

keyTerms.meaning: An agreement letting Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein take part in the EU's single market.
